title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Date and time handling
summary: This blog series covers date, time, and datetime handling in Business Central AL development, including functions for calculating special dates, type conversions, working with durations, timezone handling, and new methods in recent releases.
key_points: AL provides functions to retrieve special dates like today, yesterday, tomorrow, and first/last days of periods
Date, time, and datetime types can be converted between each other and to text using various methods
Duration data type can be manipulated and formatted for different output requirements
Timezone conversions between UTC and local time require specific AL functions to handle correctly
Recent releases (BC25, BC26, BC27) introduced new date/time methods and features like week numbers in date picker
